title: Main checks go green again: the stopped-sweep drill runs on a full history
goal: Main has been red since 2026-11-21 02:44 because the check that a stopped whole-set walk run picks up where it stopped needs the repo history, and the check machine only fetches the newest commit. Make that check pass on the check machine, so a red main means something again.
notes: CI run https://github.com/dzearing/photonz/actions/runs/44857516016 (306c82581). Fails: "a commit the app has changed since was found to stand in for landed code", then the schedule/loop-line checks, then ENOENT on <tmp>/sweep-resume-*/ran.2 at sweep-resume-drill.mjs:350 (endToEnd). Cause: sweep-resume-drill.mjs:~329 runs git rev-list --max-count=200 HEAD to find a commit the app changed since; .github/workflows/ci.yml line 110 uses actions/checkout@v4 with no fetch-depth (default 1). Reproduced: git clone --depth 1 file:///Users/dzearing/git/photonz /tmp/srd-shallow && cd /tmp/srd-shallow && node queue/bin/sweep-resume-drill.mjs -> EXIT 1 with those three FAILs and the ENOENT; same drill in the full repo -> all checks passed. Fix either fetch-depth: 0 (or 200) on that checkout, or have the drill make its own commits in a temp repo instead of reading the real history. Filed by the runner on a-long-edit-with-transitions-plays-scrubs-and-ed (pass 23).
acceptance: The step "A stopped sweep picks up where it stopped" passes on main in CI
node queue/bin/sweep-resume-drill.mjs passes in a depth-1 clone too, or CI fetches enough history for it, with a comment saying why
